# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policy (Data Source)

Use the `cloud_router_policy` data source to get a single policy by ID or name

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policy" "example" {
  name = "my-routing-policy"
}

output "policy" {
  value = data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policy.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `consuming_account` (String) Consuming account ID
- `entries` (Block List) List of policy entries (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--entries))
- `managing_account` (String) Managing account ID
- `name` (String) Name of the policy

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Optional:

- `action` (Block List, Max: 1) Action to take when matched (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--entries--action))
- `match_prefix_list` (String) Name of the prefix list to match
- `sequence_number` (Number) Sequence number for the policy entry

<a id="nestedblock--entries--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.action`

Optional:

- `as_path_prepend` (Block List, Max: 1) AS path prepend configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--entries--action--as_path_prepend))
- `filter` (String) Filter action: accept, reject, or continue
- `local_preference` (Number) BGP local preference value

<a id="nestedblock--entries--action--as_path_prepend"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.action.as_path_prepend`

Optional:

- `asn` (Number) AS number to prepend (defaults to local ASN)
- `count` (Number) Number of times to prepend the ASN
